messages.content: I booked the four-night Hotel Republic stay, but the confirmation says one adult. It should be two adults in the same room for me and my spouse. Can you correct that without changing anything else?
Yes. I’ll request an occupancy correction only: one room, two adults, Thursday, May 28 through Monday, June 1. What name should be added as the second registered guest?
Daniel Ruiz. Before you submit it, will changing the count cause the $966 total to be recalculated?

The property says occupancy can affect local assessments, so the reservation system will reprice the stay when the second adult is added. I can proceed and confirm the resulting total before treating the record as final.
Go ahead. The flights and Saturday performance are already ticketed, so do not alter the dates.

The update went through with the dates unchanged. The system recalculated the reservation but retained the same $966 total, including the previously stated $184 in taxes and mandatory charges. No additional adult charge was added.
Can Daniel check in if he arrives at the desk before I do, and will both of us be able to use the services included with the room?

Yes. Daniel is now listed as a registered accompanying guest and may check in with government-issued identification even if he reaches the hotel first. The hotel also confirmed that included guest services are available to both registered adults; anything issued once per room, such as a room-level credit, remains limited to one per room.
Please give me the corrected lodging record so I can compare it with the new confirmation.

Final lodging record: Hotel Republic, one room for two adults, Elena Ruiz and Daniel Ruiz; check-in Thursday, May 28; check-out Monday, June 1; four nights; total $966, including $184 in stated taxes and mandatory charges. Daniel is authorized to check in independently, and both registered guests may use included guest services. The occupancy correction did not change the room, dates, or total. Your Thursday and Monday flights and the fixed Saturday, May 30 performance remain separate and unchanged.

updated_continuity_summary: The March 12-15 Chicago trip remains confirmed. For the May 28-June 1 San Diego leisure trip, Elena and her spouse have ticketed the Thursday outbound and Monday return around the fixed Saturday, May 30, 7:30 p.m. Balboa Theatre performance. Hotel Republic is confirmed for one shared room, four nights, and two registered adults at an unchanged total of $966, including $184 in stated taxes and mandatory charges. Both guests may check in independently with identification and use included guest services; room-level benefits remain per room. Previously confirmed luggage storage remains in place. The May Raleigh-area wedding, June Seattle work trip, and later Philadelphia, Portland and Bar Harbor, Atlanta, Carlsbad, Phoenix, Boston, and Santa Fe trips retain their existing plans and follow-ups.
